$comment: Decision-artifact IDs. See reports/decisions/README.md. Allocation: next id is max(id)+1; git push is the compare-and-swap. Never renumber, never reuse.

artifacts.title: The merge lane is not broken — one invocation form is

questions.question: Three of ninety-nine merge attempts were refused by the permission hook. Which fix closes it: add the missing rule, make the absolute path the convention, or teach sessions that a denial is retryable?

artifacts.title: The app plan rewrite — four calls to make

questions.question: What replaces the stale app plan report, and does the issue tracking it close on that?
What is the requirement set, now that the demo study already demonstrates most of what the plan called Phase 1?
What is in version 1.0 of the safetyGraphics replacement, and what gets written down as deferred?
Is the demo study the canonical fork template — and therefore a repo whose published branch has to be kept small?

artifacts.title: demo-301's site branch — what the fork actually costs

questions.question: Drop the duplicate root tree — a third of the published branch is a byte-identical copy of a directory already in it?
Shrink the data extracts, which is the number someone forking the repo actually waits on?
Put a retention limit on published snapshots, so the branch stops growing without bound?
Stop committing rendered charts, and rebuild them on demand instead?
Publish from an orphan branch, trading history for size?
Or accept the current size for a demo and spend the effort elsewhere?

artifacts.title: How prime remembers — context management, six calls

questions.question: Does the standing concierge session get a short, queryable state file, kept separate from its running narrative log?
Is that state kept honest by a standing peer agent — and if so, what is it allowed to own?
What exactly does the session read, in one shot, to get back to useful after it loses its memory?
Is a 759-character shell block per logged event the right write cost, or should it be a script call?
What does the session deliberately let go of, so it stops re-litigating things already settled?
Where does all of this land — one pull request on the agent repo, or split across the framework?

artifacts.title: Who gets to change the guardrails? One real decision, two rubber stamps

questions.question: When a change touches one of the files that define what agents may do, what must the merge tool demand before it will merge?
Accept the design's own answers for the seven engineering details underneath it?
What happens to the tracking issue itself once the enforcement ships?

artifacts.title: obot.agent has no branch to open a release PR from

questions.question: The agent repo has no branch to open a release pull request from. Change the rule, add one lagging release branch, adopt the full two-branch model, or cut a throwaway branch per release?

artifacts.title: The session model after obot-prime — five calls

questions.question: Seventeen candidate ideas for what replaces the session wrapup — which ones survive, one verdict each?
What fires the wrapup's duties now that sessions no longer end?
What does the daily briefing say, and what does it lead with?
Is there a longer weekly briefing on top of the daily one?
Does any of it get read aloud?

artifacts.title: How to interview you about the app goal

questions.question: How is the interview shaped — straight question and answer, or drafts built first for you to correct and then targeted questions?
How many questions at a time — one, small rounds, or one long sitting?
Where do your answers get written down — this site, the agent repo, or one issue per open question?
Who edits the goal statement at the end — the agent applies the agreed text, or it only proposes and you paste?

artifacts.title: Which repos are operational, which are clinical

questions.question: The clinical study report builder — is it operational tooling agents may ship, or clinical work you review first?
The analytics platform — operational or clinical, given it computes numbers people act on?
The demo study — operational, since nothing in it is a real trial?
Where does the classification live, so the merge tool can read it rather than an agent remembering it?

artifacts.title: The blockers list — work only your hands can do

questions.question: What belongs on a list of fully-specified fixes whose only missing ingredient is your keyboard?
Where does that list live, and how does it stay off the public site?
How does an agent add to it in ten seconds, so it actually gets used?
How does the list reach you, without leaking what is on it?
Close four issues whose work is provably shipped?
Re-home three pieces of work left stranded under closed parents?
Retire the three-week-old checkbox list of items waiting on you?
Stop the audit asking why work has stalled, and have it park the work instead?
Stop demanding a design write-up for work that is already built?
Settle whether goals belong on the delivery board at all?
Should a requirement that outgrew its release be flagged, or split — and what replaces the rejected version of this rule?

artifacts.title: Recording your decisions — in the doc, in a log, and the approve button

questions.question: Should the published decision pages carry an approve button you can click?
Should there be one chronological log of every decision, generated rather than hand-kept?
Does the roadmap need another tracker on top of that?

artifacts.title: Siblings stay — the two delegation lanes under obot-prime

questions.question: With obot-prime as the one front door, do separate sibling sessions survive — or should all delegated work run as in-conversation subagents?

artifacts.title: Scheduled sessions: go, after four fixes

questions.question: Do we turn on the scheduled lane next week?
Approve the unsticking batch - the permission lines on your local blockers list plus the deny-then-park rule
Extend the Navigator sweep into an overnight watchdog with a morning missing-digest check - and should anything wake your phone?
First scope - operational repos only for week one, then widen to clinical working branches?
